policy.purpose: Do not bury genuine early winners behind the A+ execution gate. Surface one stable early-strong candidate while keeping it separate from full-size FINAL_BUY.
policy.stable_pick_rule: keep the active early-strong pick until stop, +30 target, or it is no longer an early setup; do not flip just because ranking changes

prospective_calibration.note: No numeric win probability is claimed from heuristic score. Prospective samples must accumulate first.

retrospective_top_mover_audit.note: Legacy EARLY_CAPTURE proves detection only. It does not prove v30 would have authorized a test entry before v30 existed.
